templates.title: SnapOtter
templates.name: snapotter
templates.description: SnapOtter is an open-source, self-hosted file manipulation suite with 200+ tools across images, video, audio, PDFs, and files. It includes batch processing, reusable pipelines, local AI tools, a browser image editor, and a REST API so files stay on your own server.
templates.note: Self-hosted file toolkit for images, video, audio, PDFs, and files.

env.name: DEFAULT_USERNAME
env.label: DEFAULT_USERNAME
env.description: Initial administrator username, used only on first run.

env.name: DEFAULT_PASSWORD
env.label: DEFAULT_PASSWORD
env.description: Initial administrator password. Change this after first login.

env.name: MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB
env.label: MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB
env.description: Maximum upload size in MB. Set to 0 for unlimited.

env.name: MAX_BATCH_SIZE
env.label: MAX_BATCH_SIZE
env.description: Maximum number of files per batch. Set to 0 for unlimited.

env.name: CONCURRENT_JOBS
env.label: CONCURRENT_JOBS
env.description: Number of concurrent jobs. Set to 0 to auto-detect.
